subject: AWS co-sell: ACE onboarding & PDM/PSM handoff — AnomalyHealth
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@anomalyhealth.com>, Michael Chen <mchen@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: ACE co-sell registration & PDM/PSM alignment (AnomalyHealth)

Hi Sasha / Michael —

Thanks again for the intro, Sasha. AnomalyHealth is a great fit for the AWS ACE program based on the convo we had last week. I want to get the formal ACE registration process started and make sure we have PDM/PSM owners aligned so there are no delays.

Quick asks to get the intake moving:
- Michael, can you confirm the preferred step for registering (AWS Partner Central vs. co-sell intake form)?
- Sasha / Procurement: I attached an ACE intake checklist to show the typical artifacts AWS expects. Can you confirm which items you already have?
- Internal: Laura, I’m looping you in to own the internal Redwood checklist and HubSpot updates.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm eligibility items (licensing, MSA status) — Sasha/procurement
2) PDM intro + assign PSM — Michael/AWS
3) Fill intake checklist and upload to shared Drive — both sides
4) Submit ACE registration (target: by Feb 12)

Attachments: ace-intake-checklist.pdf (stub)

If that timeline looks OK I’ll draft a mutual action plan and share a calendar slot for a 30-min handshake next week.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for predictable, production LLMs

From: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@anomalyhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@amazon.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ACE co-sell registration & PDM/PSM alignment (AnomalyHealth)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick summary. We’re excited to move forward. A few notes from procurement / legal:
- I attached the NDA we signed last year (anomaly_ndasigned.pdf) — that should satisfy the initial docs.
- We need clarity on data residency for the co-sell asset sheet (AnomalyHealth has EU customers; happy to confirm scope).
- Procurement would prefer the intake be initiated via the AWS console link if that is supported.

Questions:
1) What PSM engagement level does Redwood recommend for a pilot (dedicated PSM vs. shared)?
2) Can you share a short mutual action plan with milestones and owners?

I can be available for a 30-min call next Tue/Wed (Feb 10/11).

Regards,
Sasha Reed
Head of Product Partnerships | AnomalyHealth
sasha.reed@anomalyhealth.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: anomaly_ndasigned.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@anomalyhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <mchen@amazon.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ACE co-sell registration & PDM/PSM alignment (AnomalyHealth)

Great — thanks Sasha. Quick answers and intros below.

Aditya (cc) is our Customer Success lead who will act as the Redwood PSM for the pilot. Kimberley (cc) will run the ACE intake checklist internally and coordinate doc uploads.

Michael — welcome onboard. Per Sasha, AnomalyHealth prefers the AWS console workflow. Can you confirm if we should kick off through Partner Central or if you’ll submit on our behalf? Also, are there any extra eligibility checks for partners with EU customer bases?

I’ve put a short mutual action plan in the shared Drive (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) — it includes milestones, proposed owners, and dates. I’ll paste the high-level items here:
- Feb 10: 30-min handshake (technical + procurement) — Sasha / Aditya / Michael
- Feb 12: Intake form submitted to AWS + doc package uploaded
- Feb 19: AWS review complete / co-sell enablement prep
- Mar 1: Pilot kickoff (technical onboarding)

Action items for Sasha / procurement: confirm which documents you’ll upload and whether the EU scope is required for initial pilot.

Ben
Ben Carter | Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Chen <mchen@amazon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@anomalyhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Feb 2026 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: ACE co-sell registration & PDM/PSM alignment (AnomalyHealth)

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. Quick notes from the AWS side:
- Partner Central is preferred for traceability; I can manually assist the submission if you need a hand, but we should aim to have Redwood submit via Partner Central and I’ll validate.
- For EU customer scope, please include a note in the intake and we’ll route to the EU specialty review — it doesn’t block enrollment but adds a short compliance pass.
- Attached is the ACE eligibility form (ace-eligibility-form.docx) — please complete sections A/B (partner profile / customer scope) and section D for procurement contacts.

I’ll join the handshake call and can introduce the PDM/PSM alignment flow during that meeting.

Regards,
Michael Chen
Principal Partner Manager (ACE) | AWS
mchen@amazon.com | +1 206-555-0099

Attachment: ace-eligibility-form.docx (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: ACE intake status & next steps (AnomalyHealth)

Team —

Summary / status update for our records before the handshake:
- Sasha confirmed NDA attached and will scope EU customers. Procurement is set to upload the remaining artifacts this week.
- Aditya to lead PSM activities after ACE enrollment; he’ll own the pilot onboarding and weekly syncs.
- Michael (AWS) asked that we submit via Partner Central; Redwood will do the submission and tag Michael for validation.

Immediate action items (owners / ETA):
- Kimberly: finalize checklist items in Drive and ensure mutual-action-plan.xlsx is current (ETA: EOD Feb 10)
- Ben: draft the Partner Central submission and share screenshots + HubSpot update (ETA: Feb 11)
- Aditya: prepare 30-min handshake agenda (technical + procurement) and share invite (ETA: Feb 10)

Links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ANOM-12345, Drive folder https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ace-anomaly-health

I’ll mark the HubSpot deal stage to "ACE Intake: Ready" after Kimberly confirms uploads.

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (650) 555-0133
